# variant builders
import json, subprocess, sys, time
def build(same_label):
    edges = []
    node = 0; diamonds = 0; n = 96; li = [0]
    def lab():
        li[0]+=1
        return "a" if same_label else ("e%03d"%li[0])[:8]
    while node+3 <= n-1 and diamonds < 13:
        a,b,c,d = node,node+1,node+2,node+3
        edges.append({"u":a,"v":b,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":lab()})
        edges.append({"u":a,"v":c,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":lab()})
        edges.append({"u":b,"v":d,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":lab()})
        edges.append({"u":c,"v":d,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":lab()})
        node=d; diamonds+=1
    while node+1 < n:
        edges.append({"u":node,"v":node+1,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":lab()})
        node+=1
    rounds=[{"launch_us":0,"timeout_us":1000000,"host_delay_us":1,
             "drop_host_ack":False,"drop_ping":[],"drop_ack":[]} for _ in range(48)]
    return {"version":1,"n":n,"capacity":[48]*n,"edges":edges,"rounds":rounds}

for same in (True, False):
    doc = build(same)
    json.dump(doc, open('/tmp/s.json','w'))
    t0=time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'], stdin=open('/tmp/s.json','rb'), capture_output=True)
    t1=time.time()
    out=json.loads(p.stdout)
    print("same_label:", same, "rc", p.returncode, "%.2fs"%(t1-t0), "classes:", len(out["classes"]),
          "stdout bytes", len(p.stdout), "cov:", out["summary"]["coverage_status"],
          "upper:", out["summary"]["path_evidence_upper"])
EOF
